commit message:
Avoid OOB access when summing degrees

Degree maps can have a larger size than the max_vid, which led to out of
bounds access when summing up degrees. This commit avoids that by taking
the minimum of the map size and max_vid.

author: Kasra Jamshidi <kjamshid@cs.sfu.ca>
commit message:
convert_data now ignores duplicate edges in input

Previously, the onus was on users to ensure the input edge list
consisted of unique edges. This commit guarantees the preprocessed data
contains no duplicated edges using a std::unique call after sorting
adjacency lists.

author: Kasra Jamshidi <kjamshid@cs.sfu.ca>
commit message:
Write vertex at block boundary before flushing

Previously, when using the CSV format in the OutputManager, if a vertex
aligned with the output block size, it wouldn't be written to disk
since the output buffer size was not updated before flushing.

This commit updates the buffer size before flushing, so the last vertex
is never skipped in the output.
